historical_record.description: The eleven-storey concrete apartment building, about 100 feet high, was built in 1922 with 30 units and converted to 40 units in 1946.

Over the objections of long-time tenants, the City Planning Commission unanimously found the conversion of the 40 rented flats, let at $328 to $1,298 a month, into condominiums consistent with the Master Plan, with street trees required and a longer period for tenants to relocate (Resolution 7715).
